name: SaunaLife CL12GCP | 8-Person Outdoor Cube Sauna with Changeroom
description: Description Experience ultimate outdoor relaxation with the SaunaLife Model CL12GCP Cube-Series Sauna Suite. Designed for up to 8 people, this all-in-one luxury sauna retreat features a spacious sauna room with a panoramic tempered-glass window, a separate dressing area, and a cozy front porch for unwinding before and after your session. Built with ultra-durable Thermo-Spruce and crafted in Northern Europe, the CL12GCP offers superior airflow, comfort, and weather resistance — perfect for cabins, large properties, or wellness enthusiasts seeking a top-tier sauna experience. Features Spacious design for up to 8 bathers with separate sauna and dressing rooms Large bronze tempered-glass picture window enhances light and atmosphere Weather-resistant Thermo-Spruce exterior with 12.5’ full-length staves Contoured 2-tier Thermo-Aspen benches and arched backrests for ergonomic comfort Integrated front porch with seating adds Nordic charm Shingled roof with drip rails for long-term durability Wi-Fi controlled dotless LED lighting system with app and remote operation Lockable front door with bronze glass for added security and elegance Precision ventilation system ensures optimal airflow and heat distribution What's Included?
